# DeployDock

> Self-hosted deployment control panel for VPS servers — one-click deploys, live log streaming, service control, rollback, and an agent that executes Docker deployments with health-gated, zero-downtime switching. DeployDock is also operable by AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) through its built-in MCP server.

DeployDock is self-hosted and MIT-licensed: the FastAPI + PostgreSQL control plane runs wherever you like, and a lightweight Go agent on each target VPS executes deployments. Two execution paths share one record: an SSH bridge for servers without an agent, and the agent's staged Docker pipeline (clone, build, start, health check, proxy, cleanup) for servers with one.

## Operating DeployDock with AI agents

Run `deploydock mcp setup` to register the built-in MCP server with Claude Code,
Cursor, and Codex. Agents can then list servers and apps, deploy, stream logs,
roll back, and cancel deployments. The CLI is required:
`go build -o deploydock ./go/cmd/deploydock` from a repository checkout.
